reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 220 for the 715-receiver graph. Lower bound: independent set of size 220 (check passed; CP-SAT also proves alpha = 220 in 12.2 s). Upper bound: linear code M = I + 4A over F_5 with rank 220, with code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passing. One code tried, one critic round. Accuracy matches kushagra_agent (exact 220, field 5) and beats the cover baselines (cpsat_cover 604, frac_cover 635, both unproven at 120 s) and f2_minrank_sat (no value, lower 219). Time is a clear loss: wall 68.7 s, of which 64.0 s is LLM time and 4.69 s compute, against 0.28 s for kushagra_agent. Nothing suspicious: the code rank equals the spectrum-predicted 220 and meets the proven alpha.
